test_title: PYST 43: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: A dust storm mainly occurs due to:
solution:
The solution is** intense heat.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• A dust storm mainly occurs due to intense heat.
 
• Therefore **option 3 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Large global dust storms put enough dust in the air to completely cover the planet and block out the sun, but doing so ultimately dooms the storm itself.
 
• The radiative heat of sunlight reaching the surface of the planet is what drives these dust storms.
